ev.q: High-poverty school districts more frequently reported each of the four ventilation improvements in most schools than did low- and mid-poverty school districts
Maintaining continuous airflow in classrooms was reported by just over one half (50.7%) of school districts
UVGI improvements were more commonly reported by school districts in the South (10.6%) than by those in West (9.1%), Midwest (7.1%), and Northeast (6.1%) regions.
repeatedly surveyed school district office staff members by telephone during August 8–December 29, 2022
census-based approach to survey all U.S. K–12 public school districts

methods_quotes.q: Descriptive analyses summarizing responses to ventilation questions are presented for the overall sample and stratified by
as the percentage of children and adolescents aged 5–17 years experiencing poverty within a school district, grouped into tertiles.
The most recent response from school districts was included for analysis.
Only responses from October 26, 2022, onward were included in the analysis.
Analyses were conducted using R (version 1.4.1106; R Foundation).
